messages:
Anya (PM): Quick reviews: model catalog compare — pin visibility, keyboard flow, perf-badge a11y. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/catalog-compare
Kai (Design): Current pin is tiny and right-aligned. Move it left of name; add a small 'Pinned' label when active. Keep star but add accent gutter.
Bea (Frontend): Agree on DOM reorder. Proposed focus order: checkbox -> pin -> name -> badges -> actions. Will make pin tabindex=0 and handle Enter/Space.
Noah (Accessibility): For badges, use aria-describedby on the row to a hidden summary: "p50 12ms, p95 78ms, p99 240ms". Individual chips keep aria-labels too.
Rita (QA): Test list: SR announces perf summary, pin/unpin announced via aria-live, focus order with Shift+Tab, keyboard shortcut scoped to table.
Anya (PM): Shortcut idea: press 'p' to toggle pin on focused row. Show aria-keyshortcuts hint. Keep toast copy descriptive for SR, short visually.
Kai (Design): Contrast: badge text fails AA at 12px. Options: darker text or heavier weight. I'll update Figma with icon variants.
Bea (Frontend): Implementation notes: single announcer region (sr-only) debounced for rapid toggles. Use role="button" + aria-pressed on star.
Noah (Accessibility): Ensure pinned state not color-only: icon + text. Provide aria-live polite messages like "Pinned model Foo v1.2".
Rita (QA): I'll run quick NVDA/VoiceOver checks once staging PR available.
Anya (PM): Acceptance criteria: pin focusable left of title, pin state icon+label, perf metrics announced (grouped), 'p' shortcut scoped, toasts use aria-live debounced, AA contrast for badges. Tagging owners: @Kai design, @Bea frontend, @Noah a11y, @Rita qa.
